site.title: Climora
site.metadataDescription: A solarpunk climate console: Open-Meteo weather guidance, rule-based advisories, and open data for households, grocers, and community resilience.

home.heading: Explore the world from another perspective.
home.intro: Climora blends an orbital observatory aesthetic with open Open‑Meteo forecasts to visualize risk, temperature, and community care as if you were watching Earth from space.
home.step1: Choose household or grocery onboarding after email verification.
home.step2: Save latitude, longitude, and temperature thresholds.
home.step3: Open-Meteo provides hourly temperatures; deterministic rules summarise risk.
home.step4: Secured cron job emails digests via Resend (configure your keys).
home.noteBox: No third-party meteorological API keys needed for forecasting. Alerts require Resend and Supabase service credentials for secure batching.
home.honestBody: This demo does not run raw satellite ingestion. Instead it pairs trusted global model output (via Open‑Meteo) with an Earth-observation inspired interface, ready to escalate toward calibrated sensors when it matters.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search coordinates, cities, or risk zones…
home.searchAria: Satellite search preview — sign in to use the full dashboard.
home.featuresSubtitle: A space-grade landing that keeps Climora useful: forecast, location, and alerts.
home.featureSatelliteBody: 3D globe, orbital rings, and topographic texture make the planet feel seen from above.
home.featureMapBody: Locations, daily ranges, and context panels connect each place to its forecast.
home.featureGlobeBody: Open weather data becomes a visual console for risk and local care.
home.finalCtaTitle: Turn weather into a planetary view.
home.finalCtaBody: Create your account and open the dashboard to save coordinates, review forecasts, and enable alerts.

signUp.title: Create your account

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a confirmation link from Supabase Auth. Click it to activate your account and land on onboarding. You can close this tab after you verify.

onboarding.title: Finish your Climora profile
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us whether you're optimizing a household plan or refrigerated operations for a food retail site. Threshold alerts and dashboards use this context in copy — not pricing or permissions in v1.
onboarding.addressPlaceholder: Street, city — used for your own records in v1

errors.STORE_NAME_REQUIRED: Store name is required for grocery accounts.

dashboard.currentLocationError: We could not read your browser location. You can still update your saved location in settings.
dashboard.currentLocationPreviewActive: Using your current browser location for this preview. Your saved alert settings were not changed.
dashboard.savedLocationPreviewActive: Using your saved alert location. You can preview your current location whenever you want.
dashboard.settingsSubtitle: Keep your default coordinates, alert thresholds, digest hour, and email delivery details here so the dashboard can stay focused on weather guidance.
dashboard.advisorySubtitle: Preview uses your saved location, your current-location preview, or NYC defaults until you save settings.
dashboard.advisoryUnavailable: Forecast preview unavailable. Update your saved location and ensure network access is allowed for Open-Meteo.
dashboard.advisoryAttribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo (Commercial use requires attribution; see References). Forecasts are model guidance — supplement with calibrated sensors on site.
dashboard.weatherChatGreeting: Here is what I would plan around today.
dashboard.weatherChatCurrentTemperature: The nearest modeled air temperature right now is {temperature}.
dashboard.weatherChatCurrentTemperatureUnavailable: The current modeled air temperature is not available yet, but the forecast guidance below is still useful.
dashboard.weatherChatDailyRange: For {date}, Open-Meteo models the daily air range at {min} / {max} °C.
dashboard.forecastChatbotSubtitle: Chat through rain, heat, cold, wind, UV, or the best practical move for the next 24 hours.
dashboard.forecastChatbotWelcome: Ask me about this forecast. I can explain peak heat, cold windows, rain chances, UV, wind, and what to do next.
dashboard.forecastChatbotPlaceholder: Try: should I carry an umbrella later?
dashboard.forecastChatbotReplyRain: The rain signal peaks near {time} at about {probability}%. {advice}
dashboard.forecastChatbotReplyNoRain: I do not see a strong rain signal in the loaded forecast window. Keep normal plans moving, but check local sky conditions before heading out.
dashboard.forecastChatbotReplyHeat: The warmest point looks near {time} at {temperature}. {advice} {uv}
dashboard.forecastChatbotUvAddon: UV is highest near {time} around {uv}, so shade and sun protection are worth planning.
dashboard.forecastChatbotReplyCold: The coldest window looks near {time} at {temperature}. {advice}
dashboard.forecastChatbotReplyWind: The breeziest point I see is near {time}, around {speed} km/h. {advice}
dashboard.forecastChatbotReplyPlan: Short version: {summary} Best next step: {recommendation} Threshold check: {threshold}
dashboard.forecastChatbotReplyFallback: I can answer from the loaded forecast. Current modeled temperature is {current}. Short version: {summary} Try asking about rain, heat, cold, wind, UV, or what to do next.
dashboard.forecastChatbotNoSpecificStep: Keep normal plans moving and compare with local sensors if conditions matter.
dashboard.forecastChatbotNoThresholdBreach: No custom threshold breach is flagged in this forecast window.
dashboard.timelineSubtitle: Open the timeline to see how the next hours feel and what to do at each point.
dashboard.mapSubtitleCurrent: Interactive preview centered on your browser location.
dashboard.mapSubtitleSaved: Interactive preview centered on your saved alert location.
dashboard.mapAriaLabel: Interactive map showing the forecast temperature location
dashboard.alertSubtitle: Configure where we email temperature digests. Cron jobs should call the secured API route using {secret} — see README.

form.countryHint: Choosing a country sets the legal timezone for alerts; pick a region below for precise coordinates.
form.coordsHint: Set automatically from the region you select.
form.timezoneHintOther: Enter a valid IANA zone (e.g. America/New_York) when your location is not listed.
form.timezoneHint: Derived from the country (and from the region only where multiple zones apply, e.g. México or Brasil).
form.minAlertHint: Email highlights when modeled air min drops under this value in the lookahead window.
form.maxAlertHint: Highlights when modeled air max climbs above this value.

errors.NOT_SIGNED_IN: Sign in again to configure alerts.
errors.GENERIC: We couldn't save your alert settings.

stable.title: Stable conditions
stable.summary: Near-surface temperatures in the next day look within typical ranges for your alert settings.

frostWatch.title: Cold / frost watch
frostWatch.summary: Hourly guidance suggests surface air may approach frost-prone values. Ground and soil temperatures can lag or diverge from air readings.
frostWatch.bullet: Consider protecting outdoor intake areas and verifying HVAC setpoints overnight.
frostWatch.soil: Soil temperature (model layer ~6 cm average in window) centered near {soil}°C — helpful context, not a replacement for probes.

heatStress.title: Heat stress window
heatStress.summary: Hot peak temperatures are expected. Model-guided land context still benefits from point sensors at the store.
heatStress.bullet: Verify cold-chain for short trips from truck to shelf; peak sun on asphalt can exceed air temperature.

seasonalBlend.title: Mixed temperature stress window
seasonalBlend.summary: The next day may include both chilly lows and strong daytime heat — plan for refrigerated inventory and hydrated crews.

thresholdOnly.title: Within model range but past your alert thresholds
thresholdOnly.summary: Rule-based checks flagged your custom limits even if broader risk labels stay calm — see breach detail below.

advisory.defaultBullet: Forecasts blend global models; always compare with local instruments for loading docks and display cases.
advisory.breachCold: Air temperature may drop near or below {threshold}°C ({observed}°C in the next-day window); review cold-chain and frost-sensitive goods.
advisory.breachHotOnly: Peak temperature may exceed {threshold}°C (~{observed}°C); monitor refrigerated cases and staffing comfort.

hydration.title: Drink water before {time}
hydration.detail: It may reach {temperature}°C around {time}. Keep water nearby, slow down outdoor errands, and check on anyone working in the sun.

uv.title: Protect your skin around {time}
uv.detail: UV may climb near {uv}. A hat, shade, and sunscreen will make the hot part of the day feel less harsh.

cold.title: Warm up the cold window near {time}
cold.detail: The low may drop to {temperature}°C. Close exposed areas, protect sensitive goods, and plan warmer layers.

rain.title: Keep an umbrella ready near {time}
rain.detail: Rain probability reaches about {probability}%. Plan deliveries, walks, or errands with a little extra buffer.

steady.title: A steady day, but stay aware
steady.detail: The warmest point looks near {time} at {temperature}°C. You can follow your normal routine and keep an eye on local sensors.

hot.label: Heat building
hot.advice: Hydrate early and keep heavy outdoor tasks short.

cold.label: Cold pocket
cold.advice: Add a layer and protect anything sensitive to chilly air.

rain.label: Rain possible
rain.advice: Give yourself a buffer and keep covers or an umbrella nearby.

wind.label: Breezy
wind.advice: Secure light items and expect it to feel sharper outside.

sun.label: Strong sun
sun.advice: Look for shade and protect your skin during this window.

calm.label: Comfortable
calm.advice: This window looks manageable; keep normal plans moving.
